# Claude Code Game Studios: UE-only variant

A game studio inside Claude Code, for Unreal Engine only: {{AGENTS}} specialist
agents and {{SKILLS}} skills that take a game from an idea through design,
architecture, sprints and release, with your approval at each step.

This is Claude Code Game Studios with the Godot and Unity parts removed,
`/setup-engine` set up for Unreal Engine {{UE_VERSION}}, and its own model and
effort tiers. Upstream releases are merged in automatically and arrive here as
pull requests. Everything that differs from upstream is listed in
[`.claude/docs/ue-variant.md`](.claude/docs/ue-variant.md).

## Use it in your Unreal project

```bash
git clone -b unreal-engine https://github.com/{{VARIANT_REPO}}.git ccgs-ue
bash ccgs-ue/tools/ue/install.sh --dry-run "/path/to/YourProject"
bash ccgs-ue/tools/ue/install.sh "/path/to/YourProject"
```

Point it at the folder that holds your `.uproject`, and put the project under git
first so you can review the install. Then open Claude Code in the project (from
Windows, not WSL) and run `/setup-engine unreal {{UE_VERSION}}`.

To update later: `git -C ccgs-ue pull`, then run the install again. It updates the
files you have not changed, merges the ones you have, and never touches your own
skills, agents or settings.

## How it stays current

The **Upstream sync** workflow runs daily. It keeps `main` an exact copy of
upstream, and when a new release lands it merges it into `unreal-engine` with
`tools/ue/sync.sh` and opens a pull request. Review that pull request, merge it
with a merge commit, then update your projects with the install.
